goal: Make registry reconcile apply converge once on success and recover safely and truthfully from every caught multi-file write failure covered by G-001.
non_goals: Automatically move Done Sessions into archives
Guarantee crash, power-loss, or concurrent-writer consistency
Publish, install, or migrate downstream copies
users: projects adopting the portable registry sample
compatibility_target: The v0.4.0 Python CLI, Python 3.9+, authoritative/derived split, and existing fail-closed inputs
technical_constraints: no-op apply preserves bytes and mtimes
recovery does not depend on parsing the candidate manifest

must_haves.requirement: Normal single- and multi-surface drift converges in one apply without authority mutation.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-01 and AC-02 pass with disk reread.

must_haves.requirement: Invalid inputs fail before managed-file commit.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-03 passes for every named reject case.

must_haves.requirement: Every covered staging or commit failure restores invocation-time bytes when recovery facilities work.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-04 passes with real temporary-directory byte assertions.

must_haves.requirement: A rollback failure leaves truthful diagnostics and independently usable recovery material.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-05 passes and explicit recover succeeds without parsing the damaged manifest.

must_haves.requirement: Retries and no-op apply are idempotent and diagnostics match disk facts.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-06 and AC-07 pass, including mtime and write_performed assertions.

must_haves.requirement: Regression evidence covers the defect and preserves existing behavior.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-08 passes with an explicit test-to-AC map.

must_haves.requirement: The final candidate receives independent review and bounded closeout.
must_haves.acceptance: AC-09 records final digests, verdict, implementation delta, scope delta, and uncovered boundaries.

session_completion.completion_rule: All seven original must-haves and AC-01 through AC-09 pass on the final candidate with no unapproved Scope Delta.
session_completion.continuation_rule: Continue through M1, M2, M3, and M4 while any must-have remains and no explicit human decision or verified blocker prevents progress.
session_completion.scope_delta_policy: Deleting, weakening, deferring, or transferring any AC or must-have requires explicit user approval before completion.
